cpu_memory_scope: Actual board 64KiB SRAM RTL; identical 56KiB stack 0x22000-0x30000 with 8KiB reserved, for both CPU and hardware. Text/globals/tensors remain on actual digital native DDR. API brackets exclude boot/BSS clearing and diagnostic checksums; pre-first-API test cycles are reported separately.
software_baseline: Original T05 FP32 adjacent-pair norm and basic operators; fused comparison uses original OPT08 packed quantize_ce64 for K divisible by 64, T05 fallback otherwise.
